Question: How many claims have been placed by policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Claim_Count
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number;

Question: How many claims have been placed by policy number?
What is the total amount of premiums paid by policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premiums_Paid
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

Question: What is the total amount of premiums paid by policy number?
What is the total loss amounts, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve amount by claim number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    SUM(COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)) AS Total_Loss_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

Question: What is the total loss amounts, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve amount by claim number?
What are all the premiums that have been paid by policy holders?

SELECT
    p.Policy_Amount_Identifier,
    pa.Policy_Identifier,
    pol.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier,
    pa.Effective_Date,
    pa.Earning_Begin_Date,
    pa.Earning_End_Date,
    pa.Amount_Type_Code,
    pa.Policy_Amount,
    pa.Insurance_Type_Code,
    pa.Geographic_Location_Identifier,
    pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
    pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier
FROM Premium p
INNER JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
INNER JOIN Policy pol
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
INNER JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON pol.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'POLICY_HOLDER';

Question: What are all the premiums that have been paid by policy holders?
What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;
